finds.title: HarbourFrost Winter Festival 2026
finds.summary: Free admission to Harbourfront Centre's waterfront winter festival; some related activities may cost extra.
finds.description: HarbourFrost runs November 20 through December 20 at Harbourfront Centre. Enjoy festive programming, seasonal markets and waterfront experiences. Free general admission; individual activities may charge fees.
finds.howToClaim: Visit Harbourfront Centre and check the official daily programme before attending.
finds.restrictions: Festival hours and activity schedules vary by day. Related activities may not be free.

finds.title: Light Up the Night: Harbourfront Tree Lighting
finds.summary: Free waterfront holiday tree lighting at Harbourfront Centre on November 20 at 6:45 p.m.
finds.description: Harbourfront Centre lists its Light Up the Night tree lighting ceremony for Friday November 20, 2026 at 6:45 p.m.
finds.howToClaim: Attend the tree lighting at Harbourfront Centre; check the organizer's programme before travelling.

finds.title: HarbourFrost Makers Market
finds.summary: Browse handmade gifts, jewellery, ceramics and other artisan creations at Harbourfront Centre.
finds.description: Harbourfront Centre lists the Makers Market beginning Friday November 20 at 3 p.m. Admission is free, but goods and related activities may cost extra.
finds.restrictions: This listing is for the November 20 opening; check the official programme for subsequent dates and hours.

finds.title: The Distillery Winter Village 2026
finds.summary: Explore the Distillery District's holiday village November 12–January 3; free entry at selected times.
finds.price: Free at selected times; tickets required during ticketed hours
finds.description: The Distillery Winter Village runs November 12, 2026 through January 3, 2027, with festive vendors, lights and entertainment. Tickets are required from 4 p.m. Friday–Sunday, Thursdays in December, and daily December 14–31, plus opening night. Entry is free at other non-ticketed times, including Monday–Wednesday through December 13.
finds.howToClaim: Arrive before ticketed hours for free admission, or purchase admission for ticketed periods on the official website.
finds.restrictions: On days ticketing starts at 4 p.m., visitors must enter before 4 p.m. for free admission. Verify the daily schedule before visiting.

finds.title: Cavalcade of Lights 2026
finds.summary: Free holiday lights and skating at Nathan Phillips Square from November 28 to January 7.
finds.description: Cavalcade of Lights begins November 28, 2026, with opening-night live music from 6 p.m. and the official tree-lighting at 6:30 p.m. The light installations continue through January 7, 2027 at Nathan Phillips Square.
finds.restrictions: Opening-night programme and skating availability can vary. Check official details before travelling.

finds.title: Salon du Chocolat Toronto 2026
finds.summary: Chocolate and pastry festival with demonstrations, exhibitors, workshops and a fashion show, November 19–22.
finds.price: Ticketed event; prices vary by admission and workshop
finds.description: Salon du Chocolat Toronto runs November 19–22 at Toronto Congress Centre. The official programme lists an inaugural night November 19, festival programming November 20–22, pastry demonstrations and chocolate fashion shows.
finds.howToClaim: Check official admission and workshop tickets before visiting.
finds.restrictions: Workshops and special sessions may require separate booking. Schedule varies by day.

finds.title: Toronto Botanical Garden Holiday EcoMarket 2026
finds.summary: Free-entry holiday eco-market with local vendors, crafts and seasonal activities on two weekends.
finds.description: The Toronto Botanical Garden Holiday EcoMarket takes place November 20–22 and December 18–20, 2026 at 777 Lawrence Avenue East. Browse environmentally minded vendors, seasonal greenery and family activities.
finds.restrictions: Only November 20–22 and December 18–20 are event dates, not every day in between. Specific sessions and purchases may have charges. Check organizer hours.

finds.title: Swedish Christmas Fair 2026
finds.summary: Free-admission Swedish Christmas fair November 21–22 with food, crafts and cultural traditions.
finds.description: The Swedish Christmas Fair is held November 21–22, 2026 at George Brown College Waterfront Campus, 51 Dockside Drive. The fair features Swedish crafts, food and cultural celebrations.
finds.restrictions: Admission is free; food and merchandise cost extra. Check organizer hours.

finds.title: Holiday Hills at STACKT 2026
finds.summary: Seasonal holiday programming, pop-ups and shopping at STACKT Market through January 3.
finds.description: Holiday Hills brings seasonal retail, rotating pop-ups, entertainment and family activities to STACKT Market at 28 Bathurst Street November 13 through January 3. Check the programme for individual activities and admission conditions.
finds.restrictions: Not all experiences are free; some require purchases or reservations. Hours vary.
